3.title: Land-Based Empires, c. 1450 to c. 1750
3._source: Learning objectives as written in the owner's Unit 3 calendar (Loom, unit-calendars/APWH/unit-3.md, 2026-10-29). Topic numbers and titles still to be filled from the CED itself.

objectives.3.A: Explain how and why various land-based empires developed and expanded from 1450 - 1750.
objectives.3.B: Explain how rulers used a variety of methods to legitimize their power in land-based empires from 1450 - 1750.
objectives.3.C: Explain continuity and change within the various belief systems during the period from 1450 - 1750.
objectives.3.D: Compare the methods by which various empires increased their influence from 1450 - 1750.
